text:
samir: Heads-up — our weekly KB link-scan just flagged a small surge (about 22 hits) of 404s and shortlink rot in the /runbooks and /onboarding sections. Can folks help triage the low-effort fixes? I can batch-review PRs later today.

maya: I can take a chunk. Do you want me to claim the onboarding ones first? :raised_hands:  

samir: @maya yes please start with onboarding. quick rule: if it's an external 3rd-party gist or image, rehost under /assets and update the link. If internal, try to rewire to canonical page. ping me on PR.

leo: sharing one from the scan: `https://oldcdn.example.com/images/onboard/setup.png` -> 404. I'm guessing rehost to `https://assets.redwood.com/docs/onboarding/setup-01.png`. Who owns images for onboarding? @anya?

anya: I can own images for onboarding today. If you rehost, tag me in the PR and I'll sanity-check alt text and screenshots. Quick sed command that helps me find affected files: 
```bash
rg "oldcdn.example.com" -g "**/*.md" -n
```

docs-bot: LinkScan v3 results uploaded: https://internal/reports/linkscan/1738884322 (22 failures) :file_folder:  

nick: small nudge — for shortlinks (tinyurl/bit.ly) prefer replacing with full canonical URL or internal redirect. We had a regression where shortlink bounce caused onboarding CI to fail.

samir: good call @nick. Also, if it's a runtime or API snippet that changed, do not edit content without a pairing review from eng; just flag in PR and set label `docs:needs-eng-review`.

maya: grabbing 5 files now and opening a stacked PR with fixes. I'll add reviewers: @samir @anya and @leo for any redirects. ETA ~ 2h.

leo: ping @maya — for any redirect entries, put them under /docs/redirects/_data and add a test case in redirect-tests.md. Small example in case helpful: 
```yaml
- from: /old-onboard-setup
  to: /docs/onboarding/setup
  reason: image rehosted and page canonicalized
```

anya: If anyone hits image alt text that looks auto-generated, I'll run a quick pass. also fyi: I'll update the onboarding checklist doc to reference the new asset naming convention.

samir: thanks everyone. If anyone can't pick a file, drop the filename here and I'll assign. Also tagging @docs-bot to rerun linkscan after PRs merge — we should aim to drop the count to <3 by EOD. :rocket:
